assertions.description: 车载端的会话经协议故障代理建立（否则丢 ack 注入不到这条链路上）
丢掉的是一份服务端已经收下的装载结果：ProtocolInbox 有这一行，装载已 Committed
车重连后在新会话里补发同一 messageId 的 OperationResult，sessionGeneration 换成新的
assertions.expected: same messageId replayed at a newer generation
assertions.actual: first on connection 1 at generation 1; 1 replay(s), first on connection 2 at generation 2

assertions.description: 补发的 OperationResult 被服务端以 DurableAck 确认（不是掐连接）
assertions.expected: DurableAck for 337f8e4c-1dc9-e359-b818-4f0bd6b3af11 on a connection after 1

assertions.description: 补发被确认之后旅程照常走完
装载结果只记了一次，卸载 Committed，需求 Succeeded
补发之后服务端不再掐连接：丢 ack 之后没有一条连接是被服务端关掉的
assertions.expected: 0 connections after the drop ended by anyone but the onboard
assertions.actual: 0 (#1: relay dropped DurableAck for OperationResult; #2: open)

assertions.description: 丢一次 ack 只换来一次重连：之后只有一条连接，而且到收尾还开着
assertions.actual: 2 connections, 1 open (#1: relay dropped DurableAck for OperationResult; #2: open)

assertions.description: 车载端报文逐条符合 protocol-v0.3.0 的 JSON Schema（真车载端包写进 `ProtocolInbox.RequestJson` 的每一行）
assertions.expected: 退出码 0，校验行数 > 0，未登记违约 0
assertions.actual: 退出码 0：Schema conformance (protocol-v0.3.0): 41 lines, 41 distinct, 11 message types, 0 distinct violations, 0 known; schema compilation 18232 ms.
